usage.note: Fixed native USB and BOOT/RESET are not application GPIOs. Application IO ports preserve their physical digital input/output/PWM capabilities; analog identifies ADC capability, not a DAC. GPIO8/9 remain assigned to I2C. ADC range/attenuation and source impedance require application configuration.
Fixed native USB and BOOT/RESET are not application GPIOs.

Always on, EN=VBUS, PS/SYNC=GND; fixed FB=VOUT. TI SLVS520C fixed TPS63001: FB directly to VOUT; 1.2A buck headline at VIN3.6–5.5V supports this derated author allocation of650mA continuous/800mA peak at USB4.75–5.25V only. Not a1.8V boost or all-temperature guarantee. Efficiency85%, output+/-5%, ambient25C and thetaJA60C/W are conservative screening assumptions, not measured performance. Native loops/EP thermal copper, DC-biased effective capacitance and hardware startup/load/temperature require qualification. Complete fixed-output reference: VIN/VINA share input directly, EN high, PS low, FB directly VOUT; no mixed partial filtered-VINA reference. Additional parallel actual10uF capacitors provide nominal20uF input/30uF output. Effective capacitance remains a qualification item. Exact LPS4012-222MRC2.2uH+/-20%, DCRmax0.100ohm. At25C: Isat2.3A for10% inductance drop; Irms1.2A for20C rise. Temperature-rise currents are reference values. Buck CCM corner screen uses Lmin1.76uH and fmin1.25MHz, not a boost-current inference. Core loss, switching current and thermal behavior remain unmeasured. Manufacturer Murata part sheet, retained via supplier: GRM21BZ71C106KE15L10uF+/-10%,16Vdc,X7R0805. Higher voltage rating replaces old6.3V capacitors in this separate USB variant. Sheet does not supply a DC-bias curve/minimum effective capacitance; nominal20/30uF is not an effective-capacitance guarantee.
Fixed native USB and BOOT/RESET are not application GPIOs.

Fixed address 0x44. Use Wire at 100000 Hz with shared 3.3V supply/pull-ups; do not duplicate carrier 10kOhm pull-ups. Never issue heater commands. Wait >=1ms after power-up and >=8.3ms for high-repeatability measurement (10ms policy); busy reads NACK, no clock stretching. Validate 6-byte measurement CRC-8 (polynomial 0x31, initial 0xFF). Measurement <=0.5mA plus both 10kOhm +/-1% pull-ups at 3.6V is <1.23mA; 2mA peak is author margin, not heater capacity. Actual total bus capacitance/waveforms remain unverified unless supplied and measured; 100kHz alone does not prove timing. No powered bus driving an unpowered sensor, no 5V interface. Preserve airflow, avoid warm MCU/regulator placement; no final thermal/accuracy/manufacturing claim.

Conditional external128x64 SSD1306 I2C module at0x3C: Wire.begin(SDA,SCL), Adafruit_SSD1306(128,64,&Wire,-1), begin(SSD1306_SWITCHCAPVCC,0x3C); handle false result. This is a cable/module contract, not a bare controller circuit. Select/verify3.3V-compatible module,cablepolarity,pullups,address,50mA maximumdraw and matingSH1mmconnector. FiftymA typical/peak is a conservative reserved budget, not an observed or manufacturer module consumption.
